text:
sam: dropping a quick follow-up from the postmortem: recurring KV OOMs last night traced to slab-3 fragmentation + rapid prefix-cache growth. collecting owners & next steps.

nora: saw same cluster-wide pattern. frag slope starts low then spikes after bursty short-lived writes. added correlation tag `kv:frag-surge`.

eli: i'll take profiling & allocator traces. i grabbed a heapdump and pushed `s3://redwood-debug/kv/1765567890/heapdump.tar.gz`. plan: symbolicated alloc map + live object histogram by EOD.

taylor: i'll own detection + temporary mitigations. proposed runbook for canary (apply in order):
```
1) set KV_PREFIX_CACHE_SOFT=7500
2) enable slab_coalesce_hint=true
3) incremental_gc_rate=0.2
```
apply for 4h and watch `slab3_frag` slope and eviction_rate.

infra-bot: ticket created INC-4980 (kv-fragmentation-regression) with assignees.

sam: action items recap:
- alloc profiling & heap analysis -> @eli (EOD)
- canary guardrail PR -> @taylor (24h)
- monitoring rule: alert when slab3_frag_slope > 8%/10m -> @taylor (48h)
- retro item: allocator merge heuristics + SDK anti-pattern doc -> @nora (next retro)

eli: quick observation: many 32B allocations from prefix-cache metadata. short-term mitigation: cap per-shard prefix-cache entries to reduce churn.

taylor: canary results after applying guards: resident mem down ~15%, fragmentation slope flattened on 3/3 canaries. opening GH#4687 for guardrail changes.

sam: great. please add links to PRs/tickets and ping here when canary metrics are stable. we'll roll this into the postmortem follow-up board and track until INC-4980 is closed. :white_check_mark:
